overview_footnote: Calculated {time}. Select a number to see how it’s counted and which records match.

overview_hint_resolution_autonomous: Eligible and verified, with no human help
overview_hint_inventory_not_ordered_unkn: {count, number} not ordered yet · {unknown, number} unknown
overview_hint_inventory_default: From the configured connection, at most 5 minutes old
overview_hint_attention_approval: {count, plural, one {{count, number} needs approval} other {{count, number} need approval}}
overview_hint_attention_manual: {count, plural, one {{count, number} needs manual work} other {{count, number} need manual work}}
overview_hint_attention_uncertainty: {count, plural, one {{count, number} with an unclear outcome} other {{count, number} with unclear outcomes}}
overview_hint_procurement_open: Recorded purchase orders that are still open
overview_dialog_description: Records that matched this number at one point in time. Live changes return the list to the first page.
overview_data_through_unknown: Completeness unknown: no connected system has finished a full read yet.
overview_empty_unknown_body: Luma lacks the evidence to classify some records, so this total may be incomplete.
overview_empty_resolution_body: No issues were detected in this environment and period. Choose another environment or period.
overview_empty_inventory_body: Add a stock rule to start monitoring a stock position.
overview_empty_body: Nothing matched when Luma calculated this number.
overview_records_error_body: Luma couldn’t load the matching records. Refresh the summary to try again.
overview_outcomes_group_verified_subtitl: Each issue counts once, across every attempt
overview_outcomes_group_human_subtitle: Where people helped and where Luma can’t tell
overview_outcomes_group_time_subtitle: Measured from when Luma first detected the issue
overview_outcomes_description: See which issues were verified as fixed, where people helped, and where Luma can’t tell yet. Unknown means Luma lacks the evidence to decide. Zero means Luma checked and found none.
overview_evidence_count: {count, plural, one {Luma kept {count, number} piece of evidence.} other {Luma kept {count, number} pieces of evidence.}} Open the issue to see the source data and what Luma did.
overview_evidence_truncated: Showing the first {count, number}. Open the issue to see all evidence.
overview_evidence_error: Luma couldn’t load the measurement history.
overview_evidence_baseline: {count, plural, one {{count, number} measured sample} other {{count, number} measured samples}} · {duration} · {process}
overview_evidence_empty: No measurement entries yet, so Luma can’t tell whether a person helped.
overview_orders_description: Each order counts once, even when it appears in several connected systems.
overview_orders_status_denied: Your workspace access changed. Sign in again to continue.
overview_orders_status_reconnecting: Live updates were interrupted. Luma is checking the current counts.
overview_orders_status_default: Counts and matching orders update together.
overview_orders_paused_body: Reconnect to load current order counts.
overview_orders_changed_body: This page still shows the orders as they were when you opened it.
overview_orders_error_body: Luma couldn’t load the order counts and hid the earlier ones. Refresh orders to try again.
overview_orders_provenance: Latest order data {time}. Calculated {asOf}. Counts include only orders Luma has read and may be incomplete.
overview_orders_provenance_none: Luma hasn’t read any order data yet. Calculated {asOf}. Counts include only orders Luma has read and may be incomplete.
overview_orders_dialog_description: See how this number is counted and which orders match. The list shows one point in time. Live updates return it to the first page.
overview_orders_unknown_note: Orders Luma lacks the evidence to classify aren’t included in the matching orders.
overview_orders_scope: Includes every connection in this workspace, using each order’s current state.
overview_orders_range: {total, plural, one {{from, number}–{to, number} of {total, number} matching order} other {{from, number}–{to, number} of {total, number} matching orders}}
overview_orders_records_error_body: Luma couldn’t load the matching orders. Refresh orders to try again.
overview_orders_empty_body: Luma hasn’t read every order, so this doesn’t prove there are none.
overview_orders_no_due: No due date from the source
overview_report_description: Evidence-backed incident counts. Every metric opens the exact incident cohort; an accepted action is never a verified result.
overview_report_volume_help: Detection uses first detection time. Verification uses the independent verification time, including older incidents.
overview_report_cohort_help: Incidents detected in the period, including eligible work still pending. Unknown attribution remains unknown.
overview_report_time_help: Verified resolution duration and unresolved age have different cohorts. Open a metric to see its sample size and incidents.
overview_report_invalid: Enter UTC instants for a completed interval of up to 366 days. The end must be later than the start.
overview_report_through_unknown: Data-through is unknown. These counts cover recorded incidents; they do not prove complete provider coverage.
overview_report_rate: {rate} resolved without human work ({numerator} of {denominator} eligible incidents).
overview_report_rate_unknown: An exact autonomous rate is unavailable until eligibility, attribution and environment are complete and the eligible cohort is nonzero.
overview_report_comparison: Detected incidents: {current} in this interval, {previous} in the preceding equal-duration interval (change: {difference}). This comparison does not establish a cause.
overview_report_comparison_unknown: A comparison is unavailable for empty, partial or unavailable recorded cohorts.
overview_report_no_recurrence: No linked recurrences in the recorded cohort. Similar text alone does not establish recurrence.
overview_report_low_sample: Only {count, number} verified incidents are in this sample. Treat the duration distribution as a small sample.
overview_report_no_trend: No daily trend is available in the recorded cohort.
overview_report_sample: {count, plural, one {{count, number} verified incident in the sample} other {{count, number} verified incidents in the sample}}
overview_report_versions_help: Only recorded version attribution is shown. An incident may appear in more than one version cohort across attempts; do not add these rows to get total incidents.
